name: mobile_list_elements_on_screen
description: List elements on screen with their ref, coordinates, and display text or accessibility label. Use the ref with mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates. Refs and coordinates stay valid as long as the screen does not change; re-list only after navigation or a layout change.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

format.description: Output format. "text" (default) is one compact line per element, "json" is a json array
